verdict.rationale: Deepgram's endpoints are path-versioned (e.g., POST /v1/listen and wss://agent.deepgram.com/v1/agent/converse), and an OpenAPI spec is published, so the 'versioned APIs' half of the story is evidenced. Nothing in the pack documents a deprecation policy, sunset timelines, or version lifecycle guarantees. missing for 10: documented deprecation policy, version lifecycle/sunset timelines, changelog or migration guidance, independent corroboration of version stability.
